_meta.note: Curated deprecation entries for the integration-rot MVP. Verification status is mixed (re-checked 2026-09-26): SendGrid v2, Twilio Authy, Twilio Fax, Slack RTM, Mailchimp API 2.0, LinkedIn API v1, Salesforce API v21-30, Google Sign-In (gapi.auth2), Stripe Charges, Plaid transactions, Reddit Data API, and GCM were checked against vendor-published pages this session (see source_url per entry). Dates appear only where the vendor published them: empty announced / null sunset means no vendor-published date was found — not an invented date. Twitter's free-API dates are corroborated from multiple outlets quoting the official @TwitterDev announcement (twitter.com was not accessible for first-party verification; see entry). Stripe legacy Checkout, Google+ shutdown, Instagram Legacy API, and GitHub query-param auth carry vendor-owned sources from the original curation, not re-verified this session. Verify entries against vendor docs before production use.

deprecations.migration: Stripe supersedes the Charges API with PaymentIntents (SCA-ready); no vendor shutdown date has been published — the APIs can be used in parallel. Migrate from stripe.Charge.create to stripe.PaymentIntent.create. The legacy card token must be converted to a PaymentMethod first: pass a PaymentMethod ID (pm_...) as payment_method — a raw tok_... token is not a documented payment_method value. See https://stripe.com/docs/payments/payment-methods/transitioning and https://stripe.com/docs/api/payment_intents/create
deprecations.title: Legacy Charges API superseded by PaymentIntents (SCA-ready)

deprecations.migration: Replace the legacy Checkout modal with Checkout Sessions (server-side) or the Payment Element. See https://docs.stripe.com/payments/checkout
deprecations.title: Legacy Checkout (checkout.stripe.com / StripeCheckout.js) retired

deprecations.migration: Migrate one-time passcode flows from the Authy API to the Twilio Verify API (v2). Verify supports SMS, voice, email, push and TOTP under one API. Note: Twilio has closed Authy to new customers and ended Authy SMS/Voice support (Nov 2022); no full end-of-life date has been published. See https://www.twilio.com/docs/verify
deprecations.title: Twilio Authy API deprecated — migrate to Verify

deprecations.migration: Programmable Fax reached end of life on 2021-12-17 (announced 2020-12-17). Migrate fax workflows to a third-party fax provider or remove the integration. See https://www.twilio.com/en-us/changelog/programmable-fax-end-of-life-one-year-notice
deprecations.title: Twilio Programmable Fax deprecated

deprecations.migration: Since 2021-11-30 new Slack apps can only call rtm.connect; on 2022-09-27 rtm.start began behaving exactly like rtm.connect (the legacy response was retired). Note: Slack retired rtm.start, not the RTM API itself. See https://api.slack.com/changelog/2021-10-rtm-start-to-stop
deprecations.title: Slack rtm.start retired — use Socket Mode / Events API

deprecations.migration: SendGrid encourages v2 API customers to migrate to v3; no sunset date has been published. Migrate calls to v3 endpoints (e.g. /v3/mail/send) with the nested JSON payload and use the current SDKs. The real v2 endpoint shape is https://api.sendgrid.com/api/mail.send.json. See https://www.twilio.com/docs/sendgrid/for-developers/sending-email/migrating-from-v2-to-v3-mail-send
deprecations.title: SendGrid v2 API deprecated — migrate to v3 (no sunset published)

deprecations.migration: Plaid's /transactions/sync is the newer endpoint that replaces /transactions/get (Plaid does not label /transactions/get "deprecated"). Replace all /transactions/get calls with /transactions/sync for incremental updates; persist the cursor. See https://plaid.com/docs/transactions/sync-migration/
deprecations.title: Plaid /transactions/get replaced by /transactions/sync
Twitter free API v1.1/v2 → paid Basic tier
deprecations.migration: Twitter ended free API access (v1.1 and v2) in favor of paid tiers. Dates below are corroborated from multiple outlets quoting the official @TwitterDev announcement of 2023-02-02 (cutoff announced for 2023-02-09, later delayed/softened); twitter.com was not accessible for first-party verification. Migrate to a paid X API tier.

deprecations.title: Reddit free API → paid Data API
deprecations.migration: Reddit replaced free Data API access with paid tiers: updated Data API Terms effective 2023-06-19, and paid rates ($0.24 per 1K calls) with free rate limits effective 2023-07-01. No Reddit-owned announcement date was verifiable. See https://redditinc.com/blog/apifacts

deprecations.title: Google+ API shutdown
deprecations.migration: Migrate to Google Sign-In and the People API.

deprecations.title: Google Cloud Messaging → Firebase Cloud Messaging
deprecations.migration: Google deprecated the GCM server and client APIs on 2018-04-10, with removal as of 2019-04-11. Migrate to the FCM HTTP v1 API. See https://firebase.blog/posts/2018/04/time-to-upgrade-from-gcm-to-fcm

deprecations.title: LinkedIn API v1 → v2
deprecations.migration: LinkedIn API v1 is no longer supported as of 2019-05-01 (the deadline was extended from 2019-03-01). Migrate to the current LinkedIn APIs with OAuth 2.0. See https://engineering.linkedin.com/blog/2018/12/developer-program-updates

deprecations.title: Mailchimp API 2.0 / Export API 1.0 retirement → API 3.0
deprecations.migration: Mailchimp deprecated API 2.0 and Export API 1.0 on 2016-12-31 and retired them on 2023-06-01 (calls now return HTTP 410). Migrate to the Marketing API 3.0. See https://mailchimp.com/developer/release-notes/export-api-1-0-and-api-2-0-no-longer-supported/

deprecations.title: Instagram Legacy API Platform shutdown
deprecations.migration: Migrate to the Instagram Graph API or Basic Display API.

deprecations.title: GitHub API auth via query params → Authorization header
deprecations.migration: Use the Authorization HTTP header instead of query parameters.

deprecations.title: Google Sign-In JS platform library (gapi.auth2) → Google Identity Services
deprecations.migration: Google announced the deprecation of the JavaScript Platform Library for web (gapi.auth2) on 2021-08-05 and planned full retirement on 2023-03-31. Migrate to Google Identity Services (accounts.google.com/gsi/client).

deprecations.title: Salesforce Platform API v21.0–v30.0 retirement
deprecations.migration: Salesforce deprecated Platform API v21.0-v30.0 as of the Summer '22 release and retired them as of the Summer '25 release (Salesforce publishes release-cycle dates, not exact calendar dates). Upgrade to a supported API version (v41.0+). See https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=000389618&language=en_US&type=1
